FN-CUCSWQQ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 84
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Lance Bell
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/13/2024
Senate Bill 84 as introduced would reduce receipts to the various funds that court fees are
deposited into by an undetermined amount dependent on the number of actions, related to the
modification or enforcement of a qualified domestic relations order filed within 120 days of the
date of the final order, that would now be exempt from court fees.
Page 1

FN-CUCSWQQ-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 84
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Lance Bell
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/16/2024
Senate Bill 84 as passed the Senate would reduce receipts to the various funds that court fees
are deposited into (State General Fund, Fair Trial Tax Fund, Advanced Technology and Data
Fund, and county general funds) by an undetermined amount dependent on the number of
actions, related to the modification or enforcement of a qualified domestic relations order filed
within 120 days of the date of the final order, that would now be exempt from court filing fees.
Page 1

FN-CUCSWQQ-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 84
Committee: ENACTED Sponsor: Senator Lance Bell
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 06/12/2024
Senate Bill 84 (Act 2024-449) as enacted will reduce receipts to the various funds that court
fees are deposited into (State General Fund, Fair Trial Tax Fund, Advanced Technology and
Data Fund, and county general funds) by an undetermined amount dependent on the number of
actions, related to the modification or enforcement of a qualified domestic relations order filed
within 120 days of the date of the final order, that would now be exempt from court filing fees
pursuant to the provisions of this act.
